verdict.rationale: Render documents scaling features on the same platform primitives a prototype uses: load-based autoscaling for 100x bursts, read replicas and high availability for managed databases, background processes at scale, and changing compute plans in place. That implies growth without changing platforms, but no evidence states that the same APIs hold from prototype to massive scale without rearchitecting. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim or documentation of continuity with no rearchitecting or migration at large scale, scale limits or ceilings, and independent hands-on reports of scaling from prototype to large production on Render.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the same core APIs and primitives from prototype through massive scale, without rearchitecting or migrating platforms as usage grows
